package.description: Learn 160+ languages with uTalk — speak, listen and learn from day one.

en-GB.description: Learn 160+ languages with uTalk — speak, listen and learn from day one.
en-GB.longDescription: uTalk is for anyone who wants to learn key words and phrases in another language. Choose any of 160+ languages and learn from your own language, with native speakers, games and memory aids that build the confidence and skill to speak and understand from day one. uTalk works for speakers of more than 100 languages, and supports minority and endangered languages.
en-GB.name: uTalk

zh-CN.description: 使用 uTalk 学习 160 多种语言——从第一天起就说、听、学。
zh-CN.longDescription: uTalk 面向所有希望学习另一种语言关键词汇和短语的人。你可以从 160 多种语言中选择，用自己的母语学习，配合母语者发音、游戏和记忆辅助，从第一天起就建立开口说、听懂的信心与技能。uTalk 支持 100 多种母语使用者，并涵盖少数民族语言和濒危语言。
